verdict.rationale: Column is a developer banking API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of an MCP server. The llms.txt file and OpenAPI spec are adjacent building blocks a developer could use to build one, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
